items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: There was a guy that had a recording studio in Chicago. He had excellent equipment, named Bill Putnam.

ctx.x: And then also Grand Terrace in 1939 and later the 5100 Club.
Later the 5100 Club, because this is where we were more or less discovered by the recording studio.
There was a guy that had a recording studio in Chicago. He had excellent equipment, named Bill Putnam. Remember him?
